technical_overall_insights.1_Accenture Proposal.txt: Accenture demonstrates complete technical solution alignment using Informatica Product 360 across four high-availability environments and meets Saudization targets. However, project execution risk exists due to a Project Manager lacking relevant experience.
technical_overall_insights.2_Deloitte Proposal.txt: Deloitte presents substantial technical gaps, capping delivery at five MDM integration services and three environments while delivering incomplete knowledge transfer. Furthermore, the proposal fails to define Project Manager experience or fulfill team Saudization requirements.
technical_overall_insights.3_KaarTech Proposal.txt: KaarTech excels in support planning and reverse shadowing knowledge transfer, but arbitrarily restricts solution scalability to 100,000 products despite an 800,000 license scope. The proposal also entirely omits a Project Manager profile.
